title: Karwendelstraße, Munich
description:
Objektbeschreibung:

Helle, freundliche Wohnung in zentraler Lage mit separater Küche in toller Lage (Harras) in einer verkehrsberuhigten Straße und dort zum Innenhof ausgerichtet, im 4. Stock, Aufzug vorhanden. Südbalkon.
Ausstattung
Kombiniertes Wohn-/Schlafzimmer, separate Küche. Vor 2 Jahren renoviert. 
Große Fensterfront, mit Balkon.

Die Wohnung ist neuwertig möbliert und voll ausgestattet:  

Französisches Bett 140 x 200 cm, Ecksitzgruppe, Esstisch mit 2 Stühlen.
Kleiderschrank im Flur.

Eichenparkett- und Fliesenboden
Bad mit Badewanne
Einfache, kleine Küche in separatem Raum mit Fenster und Tür mit 2 Kochfeldern, Dunstabzug, elektr. Backofen, Kühl-/Gefrierkombination, ausgestattet mit allen benötigten Kochutensilien und Geschirr, Senseo Kaffeemaschine, Toaster.

Waschmaschine in der Wohnung
Münztrockner und Trockenraum im Keller

Flachbildfernseher 39 Zoll, schwenkbar und sichtbar vom Bett oder von der Couch mit Kabel TV.
WLAN mit 16Mb Kabelinternet Flatrate in der Miete enthalten.

Bettwäsche und Handtücher
Bügelbrett, Bügeleisen und Staubsauger.

Balkon in Südrichtung.

Rundfunkbeitrag ist nicht enthalten.

Lage:
Lage am Harras Rondell, ca. 1 km vom Stadtzentrum, 1 km von dem Fluss Isar.

Öffentliche Verkehrsmittel: Harras U6 (5 Minuten zu Fuß), S7 (4 Minuten zu Fuß); Bus Sylvensteinstraße 54, Nachtlinien N43 und N44 (4 Minuten zu Fuß). Per U- oder S-Bahn in 10 Minuten am Hauptbahnhof, im 4 Minuten Takt.

Einkaufsmöglichkeiten am Harras Rondell: Apotheke, Bäcker, Boutiquen, Drogerie, Kaufhaus, Supermarkt, Metzger, Obst- und Gemüsehändler, Reinigung, Waschsalon, Trockenreinigung.

Essen- und Trinken: Bars, Biergärten, Cafés, Kino, Kneipen, Pizzerien, Restaurants, Stehcafés.
Sport: Fitness-Studio, Park, Isarufer

Sonstiges:
Tiefgaragenstellplatz für 80 Euro im Monat mietbar. Vor dem Haus kann für 6 Euro/24h geparkt werden.

description:
Sehr schönes Haus mit 10 Parteien in einer verkehrsberuhigten Zone an der Ecke Fundsbergstaße / Isenburgstrasse. Das Objekt wurde 1990 erbaut und ist in einem sehr gepflegten Zustand. Die Wohnung befindet sich im 4 OG und ist mit Lift barrierefrei erreichbar. Alle Zimmer, auch Bad und Küche, haben Fenster. Der Balkon ist nach Westen ausgerichtet. title: Helene-Mayer-Ring, Munich
description:
Object description

Newly aesthetecally renovated, very bright, fully furnished apartment, located on the first floor. 3 elevators take you comfortably to the corresponding floor and the property is barrier-free accessible. The large glass facade offers access from every room to the large west-facing balcony (ca. 10m2), where you can relax wonderfully from everyday stress in the absolutely quiet environment. Furthermore, you have a modern and fully new kitchen, new bathroom and a cellar room. In the lower floor you have a washing facility. 

Furnishing

Fully furnished apartment. 
Entrance area with cloakroom. Living room: sofa, table / bar & chairs, TV, internet etc. 
Bedroom: bed & closet with plenty of storage space. Bathroom with bath. Equipped, lockable kitchen including stove, oven, refrigerator, etc. 
Very large balcony of almost 10m2 with a table & 2 chairs for free design. 

Position

The apartment is located in the world-famous Olympic Village of Munich. The adjoining Olympia Park offers unlimited opportunities for sports, recreation, events of all kinds, BMW World and is a tourist magnet. In the Olympia village you will find everything you need for everyday life: supermarkets, restaurants, bakeries, banks, doctors, hairdressers and much more. The subway is a 2 minute walk, which takes you to Marienplatz/pedestrian zone in 10 minutes. The belt highway (middle ring) can be reached in 2 minutes by car. 

Rental fee condition: increase of 4% per year starting from 2nd year on.
Broadcasting fee to be contracted by the tenant and paid directly to the responsible authority (GIZ), appr. 17.5 EUR / month

title: Südparkallee, Munich
description:
Amazing, spacious studio in excellent location
Light-flooded, very bright in all rooms penthouse apartment.
The surrounding roof terrace with LED lighting is perfect for barbecuing with friends or even for winding down after a hard day's work.
The large panoramic window in the living room with southern exposure can be opened completely. This creates an open living feeling with a view into the well-kept garden, which can be shared by the entire house.
The location close to the center is very convenient in a well-kept residential area with many individual houses, villas with gardens. Also the large Südpark, with high recreational value is right next door.
First occupancy after elaborate, stylish renovation and modernization.
Sendling is one of the southwestern districts of Munich with excellent traffic connections, by car and public transport.
The popular bathing area Flaucher at the zoo Hellabrunn is quickly reached.
The extensive park "Südpark" is right on your doorstep. This park offers extensive walking paths, sunbathing lawns, several children's playgrounds, a fitness trail, table tennis tables, a skating rink, curling lanes and a toboggan run in winter.
In addition, you will find numerous restaurants, a wide range of stores and medical facilities as well as everything for your daily needs in the immediate vicinity.
Excursion destinations, such as Lake Starnberg, Garmisch-Partenkirchen, towards the south-west are quickly reached via the nearby freeway connection.
Via the middle ring road you can reach the freeway to Salzburg in 15 minutes, so you can reach the alpine region with attractive destinations at any time of the year uncomplicated and fast
By car you can reach the main train station, 7 km away, in 15 minutes, by public transport in 25 minutes.



Hochwertig modernisierte Penthouse Wohnung Sendling

title: Lipowskystraße, Munich
description:
ROOM:
Your room is 10 m2 and is equipped with a bed, wardrobe, and a workspace for your laptop.

We are a professional flat-share provider in Munich. To get an idea of what we can do for you and to see what the flat will look like, please visit our website (hidden).

The flat is fully furnished, which means you only need your clothes, and you can move in immediately!

The monthly rent already includes ALL costs: rent, heating, electricity, high-speed internet, GEZ fee...
There are no additional costs!

LOCATION:
Sendling is a dynamic and up-and-coming district in the south of Munich with great charm and a high quality of life. Its location on the Isar offers IDYLLIC NATURAL AREAS, with the FLAUCHER being a popular spot for swimming and barbecuing. The Westpark, with its 72 hectares, Japanese and Chinese gardens, and a Thai temple, is a defining feature of the neighborhood. Sendling combines a village-like atmosphere with urban infrastructure and is especially popular with young professionals and families. The former working-class district has developed into one of the liveliest and most affordable neighborhoods, without losing its traditions and established local center.

Distance to the nearest public transport:
• U-Bahn: Implerstraße (U3) – 12 minutes on foot
• S-Bahn: Harras (S7, S20) – 15 minutes on foot
• Tram: Sendlinger Tor (16, 17, 18, 27) – 10 minutes on foot
• Bus: Various lines in the immediate vicinity

Estimated time to the main train station:
6 minutes by S-Bahn from Harras or 19 minutes by U-Bahn from Implerstraße

Surroundings:
• WESTPARK – one of Munich’s most beautiful green spaces with tree-lined avenues, rose gardens, several lakes, and international gardens
• FLAUCHER – idyllic swimming and leisure area on the Isar with flora and fauna
• Munich Wholesale Market – authentic place with village flair, restaurants, and culture
• Glockenbachviertel – neighboring district with galleries, art scene, and nightlife
• Diverse restaurants, cafés, and bars with beautiful terraces
• Stemmermarkt – organic shopping with a farm atmosphere
• Cultural events and clubs like STROM
• Good schools and family-friendly infrastructure

Major employers in the area:
Siemens, Allianz, BMW, MAN, Technical University of Munich, Munich Airport, Linde AG

COMMUNAL LIFE:
The flat-share:
We have a total of 84 m2, with 4 rooms and 1.5 bathrooms.

Currently, the gender distribution in the flat-share is: Male, Female, Female, Male. We try to keep it as balanced as possible, but it doesn’t always work out :)

We, the landlords (www.(hidden)), are a professional flat-share provider here in Munich, and our job is to get to know you in a short conversation to decide if you are a good fit for the flat-share.

With us, you always have a contact person for any kind of problem. You also don’t have to worry about anything – not about finding a new tenant, nor about things like GEZ fees after registration, electricity back payments, etc.

If you are interested in one of the rooms, write to us and send us some information about yourself:

How old are you?
What are you doing in Munich?
How long do you plan to stay?
Why are you the right person for the flat-share?

We look forward to hearing from you!
Your 4mates Team

title: Schweigerstraße, München
description:
Shared flat of 5 young people. Professionals or interns, graduates  and PhD Students preferred.

Room
The 24 square meter bay room is very bright, has a beautiful parquet floor and a pleasant old building room height. The room is furnished like in the photos, i.a. with a 140 cm wide bed, sofa, armchair, wardrobe, etc. It was renovated in 2023.

Location
Due to its fantastic location near the Isar floodplain (100 meters away), the Au is one of the most popular residential areas in Munich. The Glockenbachviertel with its countless bars and cafes begins just a bridge over the Isar. In 100 meters you can walk to the Isar, where it is wonderful to sit by the water, especially in summer. Bus lines 52 and 62 stop 50 meters from the house, supermarket, pharmacy and bakery are almost right next to the building. A tram station (300m), underground station (800m) and S-Bahn (1000m) are within walking distance.

All utility costs are included, a deposit is required. A cleaning lady is coming every week for the shared rooms. The rent including all utilitiy costs is 1050 Euro / month. The room is over a dining restaurant (not night Club) and you will hear music/voices from downstairs.

title: Innere Wiener Straße, Munich
description:
Bright Furnished Room in Stylish Flat Share – Haidhausen / Wiener Platz

A beautiful fully furnished room in a stylish shared apartment is available in Haidhausen, one of Munich’s most charming and vibrant neighborhoods.

The apartment is located just a short walk from Wiener Platz, a lively square with cafés, restaurants and small market stalls, giving the area a unique village-like atmosphere in the middle of the city.

The Isar river and its green park areas are also only a few minutes away and perfect for jogging, cycling or relaxing outdoors.

This room is ideal for young professionals, interns or international tenants staying in Munich for several months.

Your Room
The room is comfortably furnished and combines modern design with a cozy atmosphere.
Features include:
* 140 cm bed
* wardrobe
* small workspace with velvet chair (or ergonomic chair if wanted)
* elegant Cassina Le Corbusier chaise lounge (real leather)
* artworks and stylish decoration

The stylish room offers a comfortable environment for both working and relaxing. It is part of a well-maintained shared apartment, currently home to 3 friendly, international flatmates. The apartment is fully equipped, cleaned regularly, and ready to move in, making it ideal for professionals and interns relocating to Munich.


The Apartment
The shared apartment is modern, spacious and well equipped.

Highlights include:
* fully equipped designer kitchen
* downdraft hob with integrated extractor
* energy-efficient brand appliances
* fully automated coffee machine
* large balcony
* spacious white bathroom with ambient lighting
* bathtub and separate shower
* utility room with dryer

The apartment is shared with three other tenants, creating an international and friendly living environment.


Location – Haidhausen
Haidhausen is one of Munich’s most desirable residential areas. What makes the neighborhood special:
* beautiful historic buildings
* cafés, restaurants and bars
* boutiques, antique shops and galleries
* vibrant local atmosphere
* The famous Wiener Platz with its market stalls and traditional maypole is just around the corner.
* The Isar riverbanks are also within walking distance.


Transport
Public transport connections are excellent:
* Max-Weber-Platz (U4 / U5) within walking distance
* tram and bus lines nearby
* city center in about 12 minutes
* Munich Airport approx. 45 minutes

The rent of 1100 euro includes everything. 

A TV can be provided if needed.

title: Innere Wiener Straße, Munich
description:

Fully furnished room available in a beautifully renovated Altbau apartment in Munich-Haidhausen, one of the city’s most desirable residential neighborhoods.

The apartment combines classic Munich architecture with modern comfort and is ideal for professionals, researchers, interns or international guests looking for a high-quality temporary home in Munich.
Located near Wiener Platz, the area offers excellent public transport connections, cafés, restaurants, supermarkets and green spaces, while maintaining a calm and residential atmosphere.

The furnished room offers:
* comfortable double bed (140 cm)
* wardrobe
* dedicated workspace
* sofa
* bright and welcoming interior

The apartment has approximately 107 sqm and features:
* fully equipped modern kitchen
* premium appliances
* induction cooktop with integrated ventilation
* fully automated coffee machine
* spacious balcony
* large bathroom with bathtub and separate shower
* washing machine and dryer

Location
* walking distance to Wiener Platz and Max-Weber-Platz
* excellent connection via U-Bahn, tram and bus
* approx. 12 minutes to Munich city center
* approx. 45 minutes to Munich Airport
* close to the Isar river and recreational areas

Additional Information
The apartment is suited for quiet and respectful living.

Please send a short introduction including your occupation/studies and the planned duration of your stay in Munich.

title: Kantstraße, Munich
description:
The neighborhood
The apartment is located in the middle of Milbertshofen, 10mins walk to Olympia park, perfectly located between BWM and Schwabing district. The Luitpoldpark is in the immediate vicinity, the English Garden can also be reached quickly. On the doorstep you will find all shops for daily needs, as well as cafés, restaurants and bars. You can get to the Frankfurter Ring immediately by car and enjoy excellent connections to the city, Munich Airport and the Munich area. And if you want to do without the car, the Ubahn station Milbertshofen (U2) Petuerlring (U3/U8, tram 27) is only a few minutes' walk away, and you can use it to reach the city center in a very short time.

The room & apartment
This 15sqm private room is in a charming 3-room apartment, the apartment is located on the 2nd floor of the building. The room has a bed, desk, closet and everything you will need for settling in. The kitchen is fully equipped, it has kitchenware, oven, cooking plate, dishwasher, fridge. A washer is available in the bathroom. There are no shared living room space. The apartment is especially suitable for students or young professional who are just moving to Munich, because it is fully furnished and has all the appliances for daily living.

The minimum rental period is 6 months!

title: Otkerstraße, Munich
description:
Welcome to Otkerstraße 42!

Discover this inviting 3-room shared apartment that combines modern comfort with a friendly atmosphere. This home is ideal for students and young professionals who value communal living.

The Apartment
The furnishings are modern and carefully selected to create a pleasant ambiance. The spacious kitchen invites you to enjoy cozy cooking evenings and shared meals, well-equipped with everything you need—from cutlery and glassware to dishes and modern appliances.

The apartment features two bathrooms: one with a relaxing bathtub and an additional WC that provides extra convenience. The welcoming dining area encourages communal dining and sharing daily experiences, while the generous hallway fosters a friendly, open atmosphere, making the living space even more inviting.

Overall, this apartment offers the perfect environment for those seeking a modern and harmonious lifestyle.

This sunlit room, measuring a generous 19 square meters,  boasts direct access to the winter garden. The large window floods the space with natural light, creating a bright and welcoming atmosphere.

The room is furnished with a comfortable, large bed that promises restful nights. A practical, spacious desk provides ample space for focused work or study, while the stylish dresser adds extra storage and beautifully complements the wardrobe.

Location Description: Otkerstraße 42, Giesing
Perfectly located for students and early-career professionals, this apartment is situated in a vibrant neighborhood in Giesing, directly at the Wettersteinplatz U-Bahn station. Here, you can enjoy the perfect blend of central urban living and a cozy community.

Public Transport
The Wettersteinplatz U-Bahn station (U2) is just a few steps away, offering you quick and easy access to the city center and important universities and colleges in Munich. This makes getting to your classes or workplace a breeze.

Shopping Options
In the immediate vicinity, you'll find everything you need for daily life. Supermarkets, bakeries, and quaint cafés are all within walking distance. The nearby Giesinger Bahnhof and Giesinger Straße provide a wide variety of shops, perfect for your everyday errands.

Leisure Activities
This location is ideal for sports and leisure enthusiasts. The Grünwalder Stadion is just a short walk away and offers the chance to catch exciting football matches. Additionally, the surrounding parks and green spaces invite you to relax or engage in outdoor activities.

Vibrant Neighborhood
Giesing is characterized by its charming blend of traditional Bavarian culture and modern amenities. Numerous restaurants, bars, and cafés ensure that you can unwind after a long day at university or work while exploring the diverse Munich dining scene.

In summary, Otkerstraße 42 combines tranquility and quality of life with proximity to urban conveniences—perfect for anyone seeking an inspiring and active environment in Munich!

As landlords, we prioritize creating a harmonious and inviting atmosphere for all our residents. We carefully ensure that our tenants are compatible, fostering a pleasant and peaceful coexistence.

Each of our rooms is designed to maximize your comfort and is perfect for those who work from home. With high-speed Wi-Fi throughout the apartment, you’ll enjoy seamless connectivity for all your professional and personal needs. Whether you’re joining video calls, studying, or just streaming your favorite shows, you’ll be well-equipped to do it all.

We believe that living here is more than just having a room—it’s about being part of a welcoming community where everyone feels at home. If you’re looking for a vibrant environment that supports your lifestyle, come check out Otkerstraße 42!

Welcome to your new home in the heart of Munich! Our modern shared apartment rooms are located in a newly renovated apartment at St.-Pauls-Platz 9, just a few steps from the famous Theresienwiese.

Prime Location
This location offers the perfect blend of urban living and historic charm:

✅ Excellent transport connections – the "Theresienwiese" U-Bahn station (U4/U5) is just a few meters away, with only two stops to the main train station
✅ All amenities within walking distance – supermarkets, cafés, restaurants, and gyms are right at your doorstep

The Apartment:
The apartment has been completely renovated and offers modern living comfort:
🏡 Newly refurbished rooms – stylish and cozy furnishings
🍽 Brand-new kitchen – fully equipped for shared cooking experiences

This unique combination of a top location, modern living, and breathtaking views makes this apartment an ideal place to stay in Munich.

title: Paracelsusstraße, Munich
description:
Room 2 – Quiet and Comfortable (Fully Furnished)
Room 2 is an excellent option for anyone looking for a calm and practical living space. It offers a quiet atmosphere, making it especially suitable for people who value peace and privacy within a shared apartment. The room has a practical layout that makes it easy to place furniture in a way that maximizes both comfort and functionality.
The window lets in natural light, giving the room a welcoming and pleasant vibe throughout the day. Even though it is quiet, the room remains close enough to the kitchen and bathroom for convenience, which is particularly practical in everyday life.
Like all the other rooms in the apartment, Room 2 is fully furnished. You will already find a bed, desk, wardrobe, and seating, so you don’t need to purchase any furniture yourself. This makes settling in extremely easy, especially for students and young professionals moving to Munich for the first time. With some personal decorations, the room quickly becomes a comfortable and cozy retreat.

Location Description – Paracelsusstraße 2, Munich
This apartment impresses not only with its modern features but also with its comfortable and quiet location. Situated in a well-kept residential area, it offers both a peaceful living environment and excellent access to shopping facilities, public transport, and leisure activities.

Public Transport
The connection to public transport is excellent. Bus and subway stations are just a short walk away, providing quick and easy access to Munich’s city center, universities, and workplaces. Frequent connections make this an ideal location for students and young professionals.

Shopping & Daily Needs
A variety of shopping options can be found nearby. There is an Edeka supermarket, Aldi, a Metro wholesale store, and a beverage market for all your daily and weekly needs. A local bakery just around the corner offers fresh bread and pastries. In addition, an Aral gas station is close by, providing both fuel and a convenience shop for everyday essentials.

Fitness & Lifestyle
For those who like to stay active, a FitX fitness studio is nearby, making it easy to integrate fitness into your daily routine. The quiet neighborhood is also perfect for walks or simply enjoying some fresh air after a busy day.
Parking
For tenants with cars, on-street parking is available directly in front of the building, adding another level of convenience.

Summary
Paracelsusstraße combines the benefits of a tranquil residential area with the comfort of having everything close at hand. With excellent public transport, supermarkets, a fitness center, and shops within walking distance, it is an ideal location for anyone looking for a well-connected and peaceful home in Munich.



Kitchen – The Heart of the Apartment (Fully Equipped)
The kitchen is designed to be the social hub of the apartment and offers everything you need for cooking, dining, and spending time with your flatmates. Equipped with modern appliances and functional storage, it makes preparing meals both easy and enjoyable. Here, you will find a stove, oven, refrigerator, and sink, as well as cupboards for storing dishes, groceries, and cooking essentials. The layout has been created to make the best use of the available space, ensuring that everyone can use the kitchen comfortably.
This is not just a practical space – it’s also the place where community life in the flat naturally comes together. Whether it’s preparing breakfast in the morning, cooking dinner with your flatmates in the evening, or simply catching up over a quick snack, the kitchen offers the perfect atmosphere for social interaction. The bright, open design creates a pleasant environment, encouraging both efficiency and relaxation.
The kitchen also comes fully furnished with basic equipment, making it easy to start your new daily routine from day one. All you need to bring are your personal kitchen utensils and perhaps a few favorite items to make it feel like home. For many tenants, the kitchen becomes more than just a cooking space – it’s the heart of the flat, where friendships are built and shared moments take place.

Bathroom – Modern and Functional
The bathroom is modern, well-maintained, and designed with functionality in mind. It is equipped with all the necessary sanitary facilities, including a shower, sink, mirror, and toilet. The layout is efficient, making the most of the available space so that it feels practical without being crowded. Clean tiles and bright lighting give the room a fresh and welcoming appearance, creating a space where you feel comfortable starting and ending your day.
Even in a shared apartment, the bathroom is a place where you can enjoy privacy and quiet moments of self-care. The practical arrangement ensures that it can be used efficiently by multiple flatmates without major delays or waiting times. Storage areas for toiletries and bathroom essentials are available, making it easy to keep everything organized.
Hygiene and cleanliness are key priorities, and the bathroom is set up so that it can be easily maintained by all tenants. Combined with regular cleaning, it remains a pleasant space for everyone. Whether you are rushing in the morning before lectures or work, or winding down with a refreshing shower in the evening, the bathroom provides the comfort and convenience you need in your daily routine.
Hallway – Practical and Welcoming
The hallway is more than just an entrance; it sets the tone for the apartment. It offers enough space to hang coats, store shoes, and keep personal belongings organized, ensuring that the rest of the flat remains uncluttered. The practical design allows everyone to have their designated area, while still maintaining a clean and welcoming look for guests and flatmates alike.
As the central connecting point of the apartment, the hallway provides easy access to all rooms, ensuring smooth movement within the flat. Its layout makes it simple to navigate between the kitchen, bathroom, and bedrooms, creating a well-structured flow in daily life.
Although often underestimated, the hallway plays an important role in keeping the apartment organized. By providing a functional space for outerwear and everyday items, it prevents clutter from building up in the more private rooms. This balance of practicality and simplicity makes the hallway an essential part of the overall living concept, contributing to both comfort and order in the flat.

Balcony – Your Private Outdoor Escape
The balcony is one of the highlights of the apartment, offering an outdoor space that enhances the overall quality of living. Whether you use it to enjoy a peaceful morning coffee, get some fresh air while working from home, or spend summer evenings chatting with your flatmates, the balcony becomes a versatile extension of your living space.
Its size is perfectly suited for a small table and chairs, plants, or other decorative touches, allowing you to create your own little outdoor oasis in the middle of the city. This makes it not just functional but also a lifestyle feature, especially during warmer months.
Having access to a balcony in a shared flat is a real advantage, as it provides a private retreat while still being accessible for everyone. It allows you to step outside without leaving the apartment, creating an instant sense of relaxation and openness. Natural light also streams through the balcony door into the adjacent room, adding brightness and warmth to the interior.
For many tenants, the balcony quickly becomes a favorite spot in the apartment – a place to relax, recharge, and enjoy a small piece of nature in an urban setting.

Other Information

The minimum rental period is six months, which makes the apartment ideal for students and young professionals who are looking for stability but still want flexibility in their housing arrangement.

The concept of co-living is at the core of our housing philosophy. Co-living is a modern form of shared living where residents enjoy the privacy of their own fully furnished rooms while also benefiting from communal spaces such as the kitchen, bathroom, and balcony. This model strikes a balance between private life and social connection, offering the opportunity to meet like-minded people in a supportive community.

Residents often appreciate co-living not only because it is convenient but also because it provides the chance to build friendships, share experiences, and enjoy cultural exchange. For students beginning their studies, or for young professionals starting their careers in Munich, this arrangement offers an easy and comfortable transition.

description:

A spacious and bright room (Room 3) is available in our female-only 3-person shared flat at Hiltenspergerstraße 29.
This cozy apartment is located in one of Munich’s most desirable areas — Schwabing-West — known for its peaceful, tree-lined streets, charming cafés, and lively yet relaxed neighborhood atmosphere.

🏙 Location & Surroundings
The apartment is perfectly situated with everything you need close by.
Supermarkets (REWE, Edeka, and Lidl), bakeries, pharmacies, and small local shops are all within a 5-minute walk.
The Hohenzollernplatz U-Bahn station (U2 line) is just around the corner, giving you a direct connection to the city center, main train station, and universities (TUM & LMU) within minutes.
Several tram and bus lines also stop nearby, making it easy to reach any part of Munich quickly and conveniently.

🏡 The Apartment
The flat is a 3-person female-only shared apartment, ideal for students and young professionals who appreciate a calm, tidy, and welcoming environment.
There are two smaller rooms and this one, Room 3, is the largest, offering plenty of space for studying, relaxing, and personal touches.
The apartment has been newly furnished for first-time occupancy in a modern and elegant design with warm beige and soft pink accents, creating a stylish and comfortable atmosphere.


!!️ The apartment is currently in the final stages of setup, so furnished photos are not yet available.

Standard kitchen, fully equipped with all essentials

This flat is exclusively for female tenants — perfect for those who enjoy a friendly, respectful, and relaxed co-living environment.

title: Claudiusplatz, München
description:
Sehr ruhige Lage, in einem  3 Familienhaus
    direkt an einem kleinen Park
    die Wohnung wurde 2010 renoviert
    Parkmöglichkeiten kostenlos vor dem Haus
    zwei U-Bahnlinien und Bus  in 5 Gehminuten Entfernung
    Olympia Einkaufszentrum mit allen Geschäften und Kaufhäusern 
    sowie Fitness Studio 5 Minuten entfernt
   Stockwerk 2 DG ohne Aufzug
   Baujahr:  Altbau 1924 renoviert 2010

Zimmer:
Wohnzimmer mit Sitzgruppe
Schlafzimmer mit französischem Bett 140 x 200 cm und Schreibtisch
Bad mit Dusche
Fußbodenbeläge Parkettboden, Fliesenboden
Möblierung: Modern, teils Antiquitäten, 5-10 Jahre
Küche:
Einbauküche, mit Fenster, Cerankochfeld, Mikrowelle mit Grill- und Backfunktion, 
Kühlschrank, Esstisch mit 2 Stühlen

Ausstattungsdetails:
Waschmaschine im Keller
Flachbildfernseher, Kabel-TV
Stereoanlage
inkl. Bettwäsche und Handtücher
inkl. Bügelbrett, Bügeleisen und Staubsauger
Küche komplett mit Geschirr und Küchenutensilien

Internet:
Internet Flatrate
Kosten in der Miete enthalten

Parken: gute kostenlose Parkmöglichkeiten vor dem Haus und in der Umgebung

Öffentliche Verkehrsmittel:
U-Bahn:
    Linien U1, U3 und U7, Haltestelle Olympia-Einkaufszentrum (5 Minuten zu Fuß)
    Linien U1 und U7, Haltestelle Georg-Brauchle-Ring (8 Minuten zu Fuß)
Bus:
   Linien 175 und N71, Haltestelle Claudiusplatz (3 Minuten zu Fuß)

Einkaufsmöglichkeiten:
Olympia Einkaufs Zentrum, Apotheke, Bäcker, Boutiquen, Kaufhaus, Drogerie, Metzger, Obst- und Gemüsehändler, Reinigung, Supermarkt
Essen und Trinken: Kneipen, Restaurants, Stehcafes

title: Heßstraße, Munich
description:
Become part of a vibrant community of young professionals and live stress-free in a spacious apartment! Everything is ready for you to just move in with your suitcase.

The price is all-inclusive and gives you the following:
- Rent
- Utilities (gas, water, electricity, heating)
- Wireless internet
- Beautiful design furniture and equipment
- Cleaning services
- Registration

As a member of our co-living community, you get access to a broader network of young professionals that live in our apartments in Copenhagen, Paris, Berlin, Munich, Oslo and more. Our members enjoy shared events and even the possibility of a temporary room swap with members in other cities.

Please be aware that HousingAnywhere is an online booking platform. Therefore exchanging contact details and offering viewings is not possible. If you want to apply, you can contact us via the platform.

 Payment process:
- To confirm the booking, one month’s rent is paid via HousingAnywhere. This amount is used as prepayment for your last month.
- After booking confirmation, you will sign the rental contract and pay the security deposit.
- The first month’s rent is due at move-in.

title: Fallmerayerstraße, Munich
description:
The furnished apartment consists of a small bedroom with a 1.40m bed and a large living room with a sofa bed and dining area.
The apartment also has a balcony, is quiet and is on the 2nd floor (with elevator). The apartment is fully furnished. You can directly move in. Various restaurants and supermarkets are nearby. In 8 minutes you can reach the well-known Hohenzollernstrasse and in 14 minutes Münchener Freiheit. The Luitpoldpark as a local recreation area is just around the corner. The English Garden is only about a 15-minute walk away. 
Due to its location directly at the English Garden, Schwabing offers a variety of different leisure activities. You can relax in the Aumeister or Hirschau beer garden, go for long walks or do sports. Streams or the Kleinhesseloher See provide cooling on hot days, and you can ice skate here in winter. With the Seidlvilla, the district has its own venue. Altschwabing has a lively cabaret scene, mainly based around Wedekindplatz and Occamstraße in the Lustspielhaus, the Lach- und Schiessgesellschaft and the clubhouse, the former "Bei Gisela".
Die Wohnung besteht aus einem kleinen Zimmer mit 1,40m Bett und einem großen Wohnzimmer mit einem Sofabett und Essecke.
Die Wohnung hat auch einen Balkon, liegt ruhig und befindet sich im 2.OG (mit Lift). Die Wohnung ist möbliert. Sie können direkt da einziehen.
In der Nähe sind verschieden Restaurants und Supermärkte. In 8 min erreicht man die bekannte Hohenzollernstrasse und in 14 min Münchener Freiheit. Der Luitpoldpark als Naherholungsgebiet befindet sich gleich um die Ecke. Der Englische Garten befindet sich nur ca. 15 Gehminuten entfernt. 
Durch die Lage direkt am Englischen Garten bietet Schwabing eine Vielzahl unterschiedlichster Freizeitmöglichkeiten. Man kann entspannt im Biergarten Aumeister oder Hirschau sitzen, ausgiebige Spaziergänge machen oder sich sportlich betätigen. An heißen Tagen verschaffen Bäche oder der Kleinhesseloher See Abkühlung, im Winter kann hier Schlittschuh gelaufen werden. Mit der Seidlvilla hat der Stadtteil seinen eigenen Veranstaltungsort. Altschwabing verfügt über eine lebendige Kabarettszene, vor allem beheimatet um den Wedekindplatz und die Occamstraße im Lustspielhaus, der Lach- und Schiessgesellschaft und dem Vereinsheim, dem früheren „Bei Gisela“.

title: Badstraße, Munich
description:
Bright 2 room apartment with a large kitchen in Munich-Thalkirchen. The apartment consists of a bedroom with a 1.80m bed and a living room with a sofa bed. The apartment is quiet and is on the 2nd floor. It is furnished and you can move in directly.
 The apartment is 2 minutes from the underground station, 3 minutes from the Isar, 5 minutes from Flaucher and 7 minutes from Hellabrunn Zoo. The Oktoberfest can be reached in 20 minutes by subway. There are a few supermarkets and restaurants nearby. These can also be reached within 2-5 minutes on foot. Marienplatz is 12 minutes away from the apartment.
The area around the apartment is very popular as the Isar is right outside the door. You can go for long walks, sunbathe and get something delicious from the kiosk. Thalkirchen is considered the green lung of Munich - and the Isar meadows are the city's recreation area. Munich residents come to swim, have a barbecue, cycle and run. Tourists come by raft.

Helle 2 Zimmer Wohnung mit großer Küche in MünchenThalkirchen. Die Wohnung besteht aus einem Schlafzimmer mit 1,80m Bett und einem Wohnzimmer mit einer Schlafsofa. Die Wohnung  liegt ruhig und befindet sich im 2.OG .Sie ist möbliert und  Sie können direkt einziehen.
 Die Wohnung ist 2 min von der U-Bahn Station entfernt, 3 min von der Isar, 5 min vom Flaucher und 7 min vom Tierpark Hellabrunn. Mit der U-Bahn erreicht man das Oktoberfest in 20 min. In der Nähe befinden sich einige Supermärkte und Restaurants. Diese sind auch innerhalb von 2-5 min zu Fuß zu erreichen. Marienplatz liegt 12 min von der Wohnung entfernt.
Die Gegend rund um die Wohnung ist sehr beliebt, da die Isar direkt vor der Tür liegt. Man kann ausgedehnte Spaziergänge machen, sich sonnen und sich am Kiosk etwas Leckeres holen. Thalkirchen gilt als die grüne Lunge Münchens - und die Isarauen sind das Erholungsgebiet der Stadt. Die Münchner kommen zum Baden, Grillen, Radfahren und Laufen. Touristen kommen mit dem Floß.

title: Max-Wönner-Straße, Munich
description:
The newly and high-quality equipped room is part of a 92 sqm newly renovated apartment in Munich, Feldmoching, operated by 089apartments. The generous hallway gives a very inviting impression and provides access to all rooms of the large apartment. The apartment also has a newly furnished bathroom, with a washbasin and LED mirror, a towel radiator and a shower as well as a toilet.

The comfortably furnished room has the following furniture:
- 90 cm bed with with mattress protector
- Large wardrobe
- Desk with drawers and armchair
- Decorative wall picture

The table and floor lamps, plants, tv and office supplies shown in the pictures are for illustration purposes only and are not included with the rental.

The kitchen offers all imaginable conveniences:
- All kitchen equipment such as plates, glasses, cookware, etc.
- Kettle and toaster
- Dishwasher
- Microwave
- Induction hob, oven and extractor hood
- Refrigerator
- Washer-dryer

The apartment is equipped with everything you need and is perfectly prepared for you to move in and feel at home immediately. Of course, you also have unlimited access to the super-fast WiFi with 100 Mbit/s. The rent already includes all costs for using your room and all common areas (no hidden costs!).

You can go on a virtual tour through the whole apartment: https://my.matterport.com/show/?m=v5gApvh2RHe

Connection:
The Olympia Shopping Center (short: OEZ) can be reached from here by bus number 60 in just 10 minutes. Feldmoching's excellent public transport connections continue: with the S1, you can reach the airport in about 35 minutes or the main train station in 20 minutes. You can also quickly access the A99, A92, or A95 by car. Renowned companies like BMW, MTU, and other technology firms are easily reachable from here. Within walking distance, you will find other shopping options such as bakeries, opticians, an Italian restaurant, and two pharmacies. Both the Fasaneriesee and the Lerchenauer See are about 300 and 400 meters away, respectively. What could be better than a quick evening swim in the lake or a walk or bike ride around it? This apartment combines the popular living on the outskirts with the sought-after proximity to the city.

title: Boosstraße, Munich
description:
Semi-furnished room in charming design apartment, with big living room/kitchen/eating area. A glassdoor opening to the balcony gives the apartment an airy and spacious feeling and lets in a lot of light. Hardwood floors, quiet and directly at the Isar river.
The room has a queen size bed. There is a wooden cupboard and a old antik desk. More furniture can be provided. Sleep in comfortable queen size bed in the bedroom with high-quality mattress and lines. There is quiet atmosphare on the balcony for dinner.  Kitchen and bathroom is to share. 

There is a fully equipped kitchen with refrigerator, dish washer. High-speed internet.
The modern bathroom has a comfortable bathtub and tropical rain shower. An european washer is hidden under a bamboo tree storage space. 
The entire apartment was completely renovated in 2010, built at the turn of the century with its typical charming Munich backyard.

The apartment is very centrally located in Munich's Au neighborhood. 5 minutes walk to subway stop U2 Fraunhoferstrasse (2 stops to Munich central station), 5 minutes walk to lively district Glockenbach, 200m to the green stripe of the city beach of river Isar. 

You should like pets, because there are 2 lovely cats living in the apartment.

Minimum stay 3 month.

If you are looking for an oasis of peace in the middle of Munich, embedded in a perfect infrastructure of shopping and restaurants, only a few minutes walk from the city center, then you will immediately feel at home in the "Fabulous Flat am Forum". Comfortably and stylishly furnished, the studio apartment offers all comforts: from fiberglas internet, to the Ultra-HD TV (43'), queen-size bed with high-quality pocket spring mattress, to the new bathroom with walk-in shower, as well as ample space for your wardrobe thanks to two large closets. The apartment is equipped "ready to move in": you only have to unpack your suitcase and fill up the fridge! And here is the next unbeatable advantage of your new home: The shopping mall "Forum Schwanthaler Höhe" with over 100 stores and two supermarkets (Edeka, Lidl) has a direct acces from the building, so you don't even need to put on a coat! Thanks to a variety of public transportation (subway, speedway, tram and bus), you can reach all the world-famous sights that Munich has to offer in terms of culture, sports and architecture in just a few minutes. The main train station, Marienplatz and Stachus are only 10-15 minutes away. And if you are interested in the Oktoberfest: the world's largest funfair takes place every year at the end of September right at your feet: All you have to do is cross the street! Whether you stay in Munich on business, for study or take a private time out: Here you have found a new and comfortable hideaway that will immediately capture your heart! And you don't have to worry about cleaning: we clean your home once a week (shared cost). More questions? We would be happy to guide you personally through your new little home. Give us a call!

description:
Zur Vermietung steht eine schöne, helle 1-Zimmer-Wohnung in Top-Lage von München. Die Wohnung liegt sehr zentrumsnah und nahe der Münchner Universitäten.

Die Wohnung liegt in der Zieblandstraße, Nähe Schellingstraße und Augustenstraße und damit in Fuß- bzw. Fahrradentfernung sowohl zur Technischen Universität als auch zur Ludwig-Maximilian-Universität. Die U-Bahn Line U2 ist ca. 2 Minuten entfernt, ebenso die Buslinien 153 und 154.

Die Wohnung liegt im 5. OG, ein Lift ist vorhanden, ebenso ein Balkon.

Die Wohnung hat eine Größe von ca. 35 m2 und wird möbliert vermietet. 

Das gut geschnittene 1-Zimmer-Apartment verfügt über ein großzügiges Zimmer von dem man auf den Balkon gelangt. Die Wohnung ist ausgestattet mit: Küche, Esstisch, Stühlen, Doppel-Bett (140 cm x 200 cm), Regal, Fernseher etc.. Geschirr, alle notwendigen Kochutensilien Bettwäsche, Handtücher sind ebenso vorhanden.

Im Flur befindet sich ein geräumiger Einbauschrank der ausreichend Stauraum bietet. 

Das Badezimmer verfügt über eine Badewanne mit Dusche, im Keller stehen Münzwaschmaschine und Trockner zur Verfügung.

Größe: ca. 35 m2

*************************

For Rent: a very nice and bright 1-room-apartment in a very central location of Munich, close to the Munich Universities

The flat is locatd at "Zieblandstraße", close to Schellingstraße and Augustenstraße; it is located within walking/biking distance to the "Technischen Universität München" (Technical Univertiy of Munich) and the "Ludwig-Maximilian-Universität" of Munich (Ludwig-Maximilian-University". The underground line U2 is just 2 minutes walk away as well as the bus lines 153 and 154.

The flat is in the 5th floor of a 6 storey building, an elevator is available. A balcony is available as well

The size of the flat is around 35 m2, the flat is fully furnished and equiped.

The flat consists of a relatively larg room which is furnished and equiped with a kitchen, table, chairs, double bed (140 cm x 200 cm), storage rack, TV. From the room you get on to the balcony. At the corridor there is spacious built-in-wardrobe which offers a lot of room for clothes, laguage etc.

The bathroom consists of a bathtube with shower, in (hidden)ment es a coin-based washing maschine and a dryer available. 

Size: ca. 35 m2

description:

The cozy  bedroom (approx. 17m2) is well furnished, with closets, bedside table, chair and chest of drawers. Also under the bed itself there are two huge drawers with lots of storage space.
You can also look forward to a king-size bed with a new barrel spring mattress including a topper. The lovely second room (approx. 10m2) is also very well equipped with wardrobes, a space-saving foldaway bed and a huge desk. It is still being renovated - photos will follow shortly. The windows of both rooms (as well as the kitchen) face the green, quiet inner courtyard - although conveniently located, you can hardly hear anything about Munich, so you can start your days well rested.

The kitchen is also fully equipped with an oven, sink, dishwasher, washing machine, side-by-side refrigerator, kettle mixer and much more. The bathroom is small but nice and above all clean...

The rest of the apartment is also fully furnished. Living room with 60 inch Flat-TV, WLAN and High-speed Internet and cable TV as well as Amazon Prime are already included in your rent. A, for Munich standards almost impudent, large balcony is also included - except for a good mood you don't need to bring anything with you :-)

We have an underground parking garage (on request for 60 euros per month) and a bicycle cellar, as well as an elevator in the house. The connection to public transportation is as ingenious as the proximity to the Westpark/Theresienwiese/Westbad/Pasing Arcaden/...

____________________________________________________________________________________________

Das Zimmer (ca. 17m2) ist bestens eingerichtet, mit Kleiderschränken, Nachttisch, Stuhl und Kommode. Auch unter dem Bett selber gibt es zwei riesige Schubfächer mit viel Stauraum.
Freuen kannst du dich außerdem auf ein Kingsize-Bett mit neuer Tonnenfederkernmatratze inkl. Topper. Auch das zweite Zimmer (ca. 10m2) ist mit Schränken, einem platzsparendem Schrankbett sowie einem riesigen Schreibtisch bestens ausgestattet. Es wird momentan noch renoviert- Fotos folgen in Kürze. Die Fenster beider Zimmer (sowie der Küche) gehen zum grünen, ruhigen Innenhof - obwohl sehr verkehrsgünstig gelegen, hört man von München so gut wie nichts, sodass du deine Tage ausgeschlafen starten kannst.

Die Küche ist ebenso voll ausgestattet mit Backofen, Spüle, Geschirrspülautomat, Waschmaschine, Side-by-Sidy-Kühlschrank, Wasserkocher Mixer uvm. Das Badezimmer ist klein aber fein und vor allem rein...

Auch der Rest der Wohnung ist voll möbliert. Wohnzimmer mit 60 Zoll Flat-TV, WLAN und High-speed-Internet und Kabelfernsehn sowie Amazon Prime sind schon in deinem Mietanteil enthalten. Einen, für Münchner Verhältnisse fast schon unverschämt, großen Balkon gibt es auch dazu - ausser guter Laune brauchst du rein theoretisch nichts mitbringen :-)

Wir haben eine Tiefgarage (nach Absprache für 69€ monatlich zusätzlich mietbar) und eine Fahrradkeller, sowie Fahrstuhl im Haus. Die Anbindung an die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel ist genauso genial wie die Nähe zum Westpark/Theresienwiese/Westbad/Pasing Arcaden/...

Both are a 5min walk, and give you access to University, Marienplatz = city center or the main station in less than 10min. It is a 2min walk to tram lines 12 and 28. title: Westendstraße, Munich
description:
Diese moderne, vollmöblierte und lichtdurchflutete 2-Zimmer-Wohnung liegt im Westend, in einer sehr ruhigen und begrünten Lage und bietet vom Wohnzimmer aus einen Blick in den liebevoll gepflegten Innenhof.
Der großzügige Wohn- und Essbereich hat eine Wohnfläche von rund 41 m2 und wird durch eine kleine Theke, von der offenen Küche abgetrennt. Die Raumhöhe von bis zu ca. 4m im Wohnzimmer spendet der Wohnung den luxuriösen Charakter. Die edle weißfarbene Küche verfügt über einen integrierten Dunstabzug, einen Edelstahl-Geschirrspüler,
einen Kühlschrank mit getrenntem Gefrier-Abteil, einen 4 Platten-Herd, sowie über eine freistehende Backofen-Mikrowellen-Kombination. Ein großes Glaselement vom Küchenbereich ins Schlafzimmer, verleiht der Wohnung einen offenen Charakter.

The spacious living and dining area has a living area of around 41 m2 and is separated from the open kitchen by a small counter. The room height of up to approx. 4m in the living room gives the apartment its luxurious character. 
A large glass element from the kitchen area to the bedroom gives the apartment an open character.
The bathroom - covered with natural stone - is equipped with a bathtub and a washing machine and impresses with its modern design.

title: Schwanthalerstraße, Munich
description:
Das freie Zimmer ist hell, ruhig und gemütlich und bietet ausreichend Platz für deine persönlichen Dinge. Durch die großen Fenster wirkt der Raum freundlich und angenehm zum Wohnen.

Die aktuelle Möblierung kann gerne übernommen werden. Auf Wunsch kann das Zimmer aber auch komplett unmöbliert übergeben werden, sodass du es ganz nach deinen eigenen Vorstellungen einrichten kannst.

Bei Bedarf kann auch ein Schreibtisch ergänzt werden, falls du von zu Hause arbeitest oder einen Platz zum Lernen brauchst.

So kannst du dir deinen persönlichen Rückzugsort schaffen und dich in der Wohnung schnell zuhause fühlen.

Die Wohnung befindet sich direkt im Gebäudekomplex des Deutschen Theaters in der Ludwigsvorstadt und damit mitten im Herzen von München.

Die Lage ist hervorragend: Cafés, Restaurants, Supermärkte und Einkaufsmöglichkeiten befinden sich direkt in der Umgebung. Auch mehrere U- und S-Bahn-Stationen sind in wenigen Minuten zu Fuß erreichbar, sodass du schnell und unkompliziert in alle Teile der Stadt kommst.

Trotz der sehr zentralen Lage ist die Wohnung ein angenehmer Rückzugsort und ein idealer Ausgangspunkt, um das kulturelle und urbane Leben Münchens zu genießen.

Das Zusammenleben in der WG ist entspannt, respektvoll und unkompliziert. Jeder hat seinen eigenen Alltag und Freiraum, gleichzeitig freuen wir uns über einen freundlichen Austausch im Alltag.

Wenn ich da bin, freuen wir uns aber auch über gemeinsame Momente, zum Beispiel zusammen kochen, Abendessen oder ein Glas Wein trinken. Gelegentlich auch mal etwas unternehmen – etwa spazieren gehen, schwimmen oder einfach das Münchner Leben genießen.

Insgesamt ist die WG eher ruhig und entspannt, keine Party-WG, sondern ein Ort, an dem man sich wohlfühlen und gerne nach Hause kommen kann.

Wenn du das Gefühl hast, dass die WG gut zu dir passen könnte, schreib uns gerne ein paar Sätze über dich und was du in München machst.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.
